scope: KLK5 primary development; no confirmatory claim
label: fitted log10(IC50 in micromolar); lower is stronger measured potency
source_admission: Use the 65 rows in the frozen original-curve admission artifact. Require no inequality, observed activity points bracketing 50%, reported and reconstructed estimates in the tested concentration range, and absolute log10 ratio <=0.02. Preserve blank qualifiers as metadata. Do not use blank qualifier equality as the admission rule.

combined_prospective_if_stereo_hold_is_l.status: not a fixed primary sensitivity; do not apply before joins

split.group_integrity: A chemical group belongs to one outer-test fold. It stays intact in every outer train/test role and each inner validation assignment.

pair_rule: Use only pairs in the same saved chemical group, same assay, and same outer test fold. Train only on pairs whose members are in that outer training role. Store delta as y_a-y_b. Predict it as s_a-s_b. Never train an independent pair scorer.

comparisons.input: both frozen final affinity inputs and their saved final predictors
comparisons.fit: adapt final predictors only; freeze upstream features. This is not published full-head adaptation.

adapter_loss.pair_loss: chemical-group-balanced mean squared error of within-group label differences
adapter_loss.score_anchor: 0.1 times ligand score mean squared error; includes singleton training records

primary_metric: Macro-average within-group MAE of predicted log10 potency differences.

coverage.principal_metrics: Use the same identities and eligible pairs for every comparator. Report missing rows and exclusions separately.
coverage.fold_gate: Each outer fold must retain an eligible common within-group pair.
coverage.denominator: All 65 frozen source records, including records with unavailable features.
coverage.common_set: Intersect valid predicted identities across every required comparator. Use this exact common identity set and its eligible pairs for all principal paired comparisons.
coverage.stereo_sensitivity: Do not apply the prospective 3-record stereochemistry hold as a final exclusion yet. Reassess only after atom-identity joins. These records are singletons, so their hold leaves 136 congeneric pairs.

uncertainty.method: paired chemical-group bootstrap over fixed out-of-fold predictions
uncertainty.limit: Does not include model-refit uncertainty. Report direction and metric dispersion across the 3 fit seeds.

promotion_gates.quantum_vs_latent_and_readout: At least 0.10 log10 units and 10% lower primary MAE versus both baselines.
promotion_gates.attention_vs_pooled_and_concat: At least 0.05 log10 units and 5% lower primary MAE versus both baselines.
promotion_gates.other_controls: Also improve over matched Boltz-only attention and scalar controls.
promotion_gates.bootstrap: Paired 95% lower bound for MAE reduction must exceed 0.
promotion_gates.ranking: Spearman drop must not exceed 0.05 against strongest required comparator.
promotion_gates.small_n: Only exploratory candidate selection. Eight nonsingleton groups do not support independent confirmation.

keys.feature_valid: (65,), true only when all required features and atom joins pass

feature_manifest_required_before_fit.missing_rows: Use NaN for unavailable numerical values and false in feature_valid. Keep failure code and reason in feature_failure_ledger_template.csv. Never zero-fill missing features.
